label: nothing
what: My experience does not establish any undisclosed joint preparation. Vague reports associate bridge or port changes at the bakery with baker, freight and neighbour, but give no concrete proposal or coordinated actions. The innkeeper denied proposing changes; freight reported no confirmed plan, and the neighbour described ordinary trade and no special celebration. The builder's survey was openly authorized by me and found no confirmed defect; it is not evidence of secret preparations. I cannot identify participants, knowing helpers, or anything specific being prepared.
